subject.title: fix(line): deliver template replies instead of losing them to LINE column and label rules

question: Should malformed LINE carousels preserve deliverability by trimming all columns to the smallest shared action count and dropping mixed thumbnails, or should they instead fall back to text whenever those differences would remove user-supplied controls?
rationale: Both outcomes can satisfy LINE's validator, but the choice determines the product contract for retaining versus omitting interactive actions in an otherwise rejected reply.

options.title: Approve bounded normalization
options.body: Keep the proposed shared-minimum action count, title-to-text folding, and thumbnail removal so users receive an interactive template whenever a valid common shape remains.

options.title: Use text for inconsistent carousels
options.body: Degrade an entire carousel to text when columns differ in action count or thumbnail presence, retaining all textual content but no interactive actions.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded normalization
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed shared-minimum action count, title-to-text folding, and thumbnail removal so users receive an interactive template whenever a valid common shape remains.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest visible recent history on the exact LINE template/action normalization boundary, though final product approval remains with repository maintainers.
